item.title: Capitals activate Pierre-Luc Dubois and Logan Thompson from injured reserve, return goaltender Garin Bjorklund to AHL’s Hershey Bears
item.description: The Washington Capitals returned goaltender Garin Bjorklund to the AHL’s Hershey Bears on Thursday afternoon. Bjorklund was recalled by the Capitals on January 31 after Charlie Lindgren suffered an injury against the Detroit Red Wings. item.title: Jakob Chychrun scores goal of the year candidate for an NHL defenseman, hits 20 goals with Capitals for second consecutive season
item.description: Jakob Chychrun was the Washington Capitals’ hero against the Nashville Predators. Not only did Chychrun skate nearly 30 minutes in the game with John Carlson injured, but he was productive in those minutes, too. He scored twice, including the game-winning goal, and tallied three points — his 11th career game with three points or more.
